# Cytogent

> Cytogent is an agentic workspace for life science research. Scientists write what they want to find out; Cytogent turns it into a research brief, and AI agents and people plan and do the work together across literature, in-silico studies, protein design, CRISPR, clinical trials, and regulatory and patent documents. Every result is cited and signed off.

Cytogent is operated by WelloWork AB, a company registered in Sweden.

## What it is

Cytogent is an agentic workspace for life science research. Scientists write what they want to find out; Cytogent turns it into a research brief, and AI agents and people plan and do the work together across literature, in-silico studies, protein design, CRISPR, clinical trials, and regulatory and patent documents. Every result is cited and signed off.

Access is by request only. There is no self sign-up and no free trial. Three request types: Individual, Institute, Hospital.

Cytogent is a research tool. It is not a medical device and makes no clinical decisions. Agents draft, search, predict and support; a qualified scientist reviews and decides.

## How it works

1. Write: Your goal in plain language. Attach data or connect your sources.
2. Brief: Cytogent asks a few questions. You confirm and sign the research brief.
3. Work: Agents and people do the tasks. Each step goes to the best model and is logged.
4. Decide: Review cited results, sign off, and export to your notebook, LIMS or report.

## Why teams choose Cytogent

- A signed research brief: Cytogent turns a rough idea into a one-page brief with question, controls, endpoints and rules. Agents plan from it.
- Tasks for people, not only agents: Agents create lab work, reviews and approvals for people, with the protocol attached. Results return to the record.
- Science models built in: Structure prediction, docking, protein design and CRISPR guide checks run inside the project.
- One evidence trail: Every claim links to a source you can open, from the brief to the final file, across all seven workflows.
- Documents reviewers expect: Protocol, CRF, SAP, CSR, IND/CTA, IVDR and patent claims are built from the same cited results.
- Scientist sign-off on record: Each checkpoint waits for a named person. The sign-off is saved in the audit log.

## Who it is for

- Pharma & biotech R&D: Target triage, candidate ranking and design loops with cited sources. (https://cytogent.com/industries/pharma-and-biotech/)
- CROs & clinical teams: Trial documents drafted from your study data, ready for review. (https://cytogent.com/industries/cro-and-clinical-teams/)
- Hospitals & academic labs: Analysis and writing with a full audit trail inside your permissions. (https://cytogent.com/industries/hospitals-and-academic-labs/)
- Regulatory & IP teams: Structured drafts for IND/CTA, IVDR files and patent applications. (https://cytogent.com/industries/regulatory-and-ip-teams/)

## Workflows

- Literature & evidence: Papers, patents, protocols and registries in one query. Every claim points to its source. (https://cytogent.com/solutions/literature-and-evidence/)
- In-silico studies: Screen, simulate and compare before the bench: docking, ADMET, pathway and PK models. (https://cytogent.com/solutions/in-silico-studies/)
- Protein studies & design: Structure prediction, binding analysis and sequence design, with validation reports. (https://cytogent.com/solutions/protein-design/)
- CRISPR & genome editing: Guide design, off-target review and screen analysis, documented for the lab. (https://cytogent.com/solutions/crispr-genome-editing/)
- Clinical trials, full cycle: Protocol drafts, site feasibility, cohort criteria, CRFs, statistical analysis plans, monitoring summaries and CSR drafts. (https://cytogent.com/solutions/clinical-trials/)
- Regulatory documentation: IND/CTA modules, IVDR technical files and SOPs, structured for reviewer questions. (https://cytogent.com/solutions/regulatory-documentation/)
- Patent & IP documentation: Prior-art search, invention disclosures and claim-drafting support from your own results. (https://cytogent.com/solutions/patent-documentation/)

## Facts

- Product: Cytogent
- Operator: WelloWork AB
- Country: Sweden
- Data: project data is isolated and never trains shared models
- EU data residency: in progress
- Access: by request only
- Contact: info@cytogent.com
- NVIDIA Inception Program: WelloWork AB, the company behind Cytogent, is a member. Science models run through NVIDIA BioNeMo NIM microservices (OpenFold, DiffDock, ESM, RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN) and NVIDIA Parabricks. NVIDIA, BioNeMo, NIM and Parabricks are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation. Inception Program membership does not imply NVIDIA endorsement.
